$comment: The docs' Content-Security-Policy (W2.2 of PLAN-design.md): the pages under /docs/, which `npm run gen:csp` writes under /docs/* and /pagefind/* in packages/site/public/_headers (Pagefind searches in a worker, and a worker has the policy of its own script's response), after detaching the site's (security/csp-site.json).

It is the site's policy and one more thing: 'wasm-unsafe-eval', which compiles the search's WebAssembly (Pagefind: /pagefind/pagefind-ui.js, its index and its WebAssembly, and /docs-search.js, which starts it); it allows no eval of text. No inline script and no third party (maintainer, 2026-10-16: search on /docs/ only).
img-src data: is Pagefind's stylesheet, which draws its search and clear icons as data: SVGs.
